sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
World Wide Sign Systems manufactures wholesale electric sign products including formed faces, cabinets, channel letters, and digital graphics, operating four manufacturing facilities nationwide since 1958.

Industry: Manufacturing · HQ: Bonduel, Wisconsin · Size: 50-249 · Products: Formed Face Signs, Channel Letters, Extruded Cabinet Signs, Fabricated Cabinet Signs, Flex Face Signs, Digital Graphic Signs

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: World Wide Sign Systems Inc. scores 28 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (12/30), company size (6/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15). Nothing was found for application fit and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on weatherability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (13% similar on sign, digital, graphic, vinyl); Drytac (12% similar on sign, manufacturing, graphics, graphic); ORAFOL Europe (7% similar on graphic, digital, wide, graphics). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.
